snippet.title: Fill the Sky - Official Trailer | Factory automation on an island world
snippet.description:
Fill the Sky is a factory automation game where you are the mind of a self-replicating interstellar probe. Turn barren rock and ocean into industry that feeds the data centers your mind runs on, and launch copies of yourself until they fill the sky.

Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/5139580/Fill_the_Sky/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=videos&utm_content=trailer1

Music: "Ascension" by Scott Buckley, CC BY 4.0
